verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents converting a URL into HTML, JSON or markdown, but these are whole-page output formats. Nothing in the evidence shows an option to request semantically chunked output for retrieval pipelines. Chunking is a fair axis for a web-context fetch product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can request semantically chunked output instead of one large content blob, so it feeds cleanly into a retrieval pipeline
